svg.text: - Listinit: Initializes all pointers to NULL and size to 0
- vInsertion: Adds a node, updates nTail, and increments size
- vInsertion2: Adds a node at a specific position, updates nTail, and increments size
- vRemove: Removes a node, updates pointers, and decrements size
- vSearch: Traverses the list without modifying it
- vPrint: Traverses the list and prints data without modifying it
